sections.heading: 1. Nutrition in Animals
points: Animals are **heterotrophs** — they take in food made by plants or other animals.

sections.heading: 2. The Human Digestive System
points: Path (alimentary canal): **mouth → oesophagus (food pipe) → stomach → small intestine → large intestine → rectum → anus**.
**Mouth:** teeth chew; **saliva** (from salivary glands) begins digesting **starch**.
**Stomach:** churns food; secretes **acid and juices** that digest proteins and kill germs.
**Small intestine:** main site of **digestion and absorption**; helped by **bile (liver)** and **pancreatic juice**; nutrients absorbed through finger-like **villi**.
**Large intestine:** absorbs **water**; **liver** = largest gland; **anus** removes faeces.

sections.heading: 3. Teeth
points: Types of teeth: **incisors** (cutting/biting), **canines** (tearing), **premolars & molars** (grinding).
Two sets in life: **milk teeth** (childhood) → **permanent teeth**.
Tooth decay is caused by **bacteria acting on sugar** → acid → cavities; brushing helps.

sections.heading: 4. Nutrition in Ruminants and Amoeba
points: **Ruminants** (cow, buffalo, deer) quickly swallow grass into a part of the stomach called the **rumen**, where it becomes **cud**; later they bring it back to the mouth and chew it slowly (**rumination / chewing the cud**). They can digest **cellulose** (grass) with the help of microbes.
**Amoeba** (a single-celled organism) eats using **pseudopodia** (false feet) to surround food, forming a **food vacuole** where digestion occurs.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Five steps: ingestion, digestion, absorption, assimilation, egestion.
Digestive path: mouth → oesophagus → stomach → small intestine → large intestine → anus.
Saliva digests starch; stomach acid digests protein; small intestine = main absorption (villi).
Teeth: incisors (cut), canines (tear), premolars & molars (grind); liver = largest gland.
Ruminants chew cud (rumen), digest cellulose; Amoeba eats via pseudopodia + food vacuole.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **small intestine** is the main site of **digestion & absorption** (via villi); the large intestine mainly absorbs **water**.
**Ruminants** (not all herbivores) chew the **cud** and digest **cellulose** with microbes.
**Amoeba** engulfs food with **pseudopodia**, forming a **food vacuole**.
Saliva acts on **starch (carbohydrate)**, not protein.
